verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was to me, “
verses.2: The son of man was born, and you said, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: It shall be done today.”
verses.3: For it will be a day of darkness and a time of gloom for the nations.
verses.4: And in Egypt, there was a plague of darkness. It spread throughout Egypt’s land. They took away its treasures, and its idols were destroyed.
verses.5: Kush, Put, Lud, and all the other nations of the land will be destroyed in the time of judgment.
verses.6: So said Yahweh: “And the gods of Egypt will fall down. A great disaster will come from Mount Sinai. They will fall there, says the Lord God.”
verses.7: And they will be destroyed within their own lands; their cities will be destroyed within their own towns.
verses.8: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, who has sent fire upon Egypt. Then all their helpers will be destroyed.
verses.9: On that day, the demons rushed out from before me in flames. They caused sores on them. It was a day of suffering for them, just as it was for the people of Egypt when they were brought forth from their land.
verses.10: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will take back my people from Egypt, through Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon.”
verses.11: He and his people were tyrants of other nations who came to destroy the land. They destroyed its ruins, and filled the land with chaos.
verses.12: And I will give it over to those who are evil. I will take possession of the land in the hands of those who are not worthy. I will fill the land with foreigners. I, Jehovah, have spoken this.
verses.13: As Adonai Yehovah has said: “I have destroyed all the idols and abolished all the priests who worshiped them. I will no longer allow them to exist in Egypt. I will give fear to the people of Egypt.”
verses.14: And I filled Phathros with fire, and I set fire to the wood. Then I made judgments among them.
verses.15: And I poured my hot blood upon Syria, along with the curse of Egypt. And I recognized its nature.
verses.16: And I will put fire in Egypt. It will burn completely, and it will no longer be able to be extinguished. The people of Egypt will suffer greatly in those days.
verses.17: In the days of Awn and Pi-Beset, they will fall. Now, in this place, they will be destroyed.
verses.18: And today, in Shivri-Sham, you shall see the feet of Egypt being lifted up. It’s like a vast cloud that covers everything. Its branches spread out in all directions.
verses.19: And I made judgments among the Egyptians, and they knew that I was Jehovah.
verses.20: And in the eleventh year, at the beginning of the seventh month, God said to me:
verses.21: I broke the branches of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. But it seems that they still haven’t been healed yet. I need to give them some time to recover and become stronger.
verses.22: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will go to Pharaoh, king of Egypt. I will destroy his descendants, both the strong and the weak. I will also destroy his army with my own hands.”
verses.23: And I will scatter their nations among the nations, and their families among their own lands.
verses.24: And I strengthened the seeds of King Babylon. I gave him his weapons in his hands, and I destroyed the seeds of Pharaoh’s kingdom. Then I made a noise in the heavens before him.
verses.25: And I will strengthen the seeds of King Babylon, and the seeds of Pharaoh Tiglath-Pileser. They shall know that I am Jehovah, who will destroy their city with the hands of King Babylon. And I will turn them over to the land of Egypt.
verses.26: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations; I will bring them into their own land. Then they will know that I, Jehovah, am their God.
